title: Former Camden schools chief Paymon Rouhanifard on testing: ‘The drawbacks currently outweigh the benefits’
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Bookmarked: Former Camden schools chief Paymon Rouhanifard on testing: ‘The drawbacks currently outweigh the benefits’

https://www.chalkbeat.org/posts/us/2018/11/13/former-camden-superintendent-on-testing-the-drawbacks-currently-outweigh-the-benefits/

Glad to see former #edreform folks realizing the futility of the testing regime they saddled our school systems with the last three decades.

Seeing madness spread to #HigherEd as the Pearson's of the world see the k12 trough drying up.
